subject.title: Nextcloud Talk current-room aliases fail with previous external plugin releases

question: Should OpenClaw preserve current-room target aliases for the previous external Nextcloud Talk plugin release through the proposed shared dispatch compatibility path?
rationale: The issue is protected with the `maintainer` label, and the linked implementation crosses a compatibility boundary between current core and a prior external plugin release.

options.title: Accept the scoped compatibility bridge
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if its shared dispatch path preserves existing target interpretation outside the documented external-plugin upgrade case.

options.title: Require an owner-plugin-only release path
options.body: Keep the issue open and request a narrower Nextcloud Talk plugin solution if core should not carry compatibility for prior external plugin releases.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped compatibility bridge
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if its shared dispatch path preserves existing target interpretation outside the documented external-plugin upgrade case.
